candidate_B.rule: short iff (high_jump AND contango) OR (low_jump AND backwardation); otherwise flat

FREEZE_CANDIDATE_A if A passes notable-edge gates and B does not clear its extra promotion gate
REJECT_OR_MATERIALLY_WEAKEN_SHORT_REGIME_THESIS if neither eligible frozen identity passes
stop_and_no_rescue_rules: No new feature, threshold, deadband, holding rule, sizing rule, learned model, direction exception, or state definition may be selected from Blocks2-4 before this comparison is interpreted.

No direct Jump sign rule is eligible.
